query: SELECT "public"."global_step_events"."id", "public"."global_step_events"."starts_at", "public"."global_step_events"."ends_at", "public"."global_step_events"."multiplier", "public"."global_step_events"."label", "public"."global_step_events"."schedule_mode", "public"."global_step_events"."event_day", "public"."global_step_events"."local_start_minute", "public"."global_step_events"."duration_minutes", "public"."global_step_events"."schedule_policy_version", "public"."global_step_events"."created_at" FROM "public"."global_step_events" WHERE ("public"."global_step_events"."schedule_mode" = $1 AND ("public"."global_step_events"."ends_at" > $2 OR EXISTS(SELECT "t0"."event_id" FROM "public"."global_step_event_entitlements" AS "t0" WHERE (("t0"."start_processed_at" IS NULL OR "t0"."end_processed_at" IS NULL) AND ("public"."global_step_events"."id") = ("t0"."event_id") AND "t0"."event_id" IS NOT NULL)))) ORDER BY "public"."global_step_events"."starts_at" ASC OFFSET $3
